name: capability.census
description: Advisory. Judge a capability census: are counts read from the machine today, are drops explained, and is every gap given an owner.

counts_measured.instructions: Every count comes from a command or a file read on this run, not from a prior report

deltas_explained.instructions: Any drop against the previous census is named and explained

gaps_have_owner.instructions: Each capability gap is assigned to a person, a lane, or an explicit no-owner

no_symlink_double_count.instructions: Counts state whether symlinked or nested stores are included, so numbers stay comparable

rules.reason: a census built from notes is a hypothesis, not a status
unbounded counts are not comparable between runs

calibration.note: Authored 2026-10-05 by session GqYCYA10TAeQlT5l from the OpenDots expert rubric-gap census (both judges abstained on every existing rubric). Calibrate on labelled runs before enforcement. Advisory by construction: rules emit PASS or ESCALATE only, no BLOCK.
